verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the AI can hand work to parallel sub-agents through a delegate_task tool. A separate use-case page describes running parallel agents, one per worktree and workspace, all supervised from one browser tab. Together these directly cover splitting and parallelizing real work. missing for 10: an agent-to-agent protocol or swarm coordination beyond delegation, in-depth docs on how subagents coordinate and merge results, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the subagent features work as described.
